Use distributivity and factor out the scalars:

$$
\begin{aligned}(\mathbf a-2\mathbf b)\times(4\mathbf c)&=4(\mathbf a\times\mathbf c)-8(\mathbf b\times\mathbf c)\\&=4\langle3,2,0\\rangle-8\langle2,3,0\\rangle\\&=\langle-4,-16,0\\rangle.\end{aligned}
$$
